+"""Standalone helper to find the real function behind wrappers and partials.
+
+This module intentionally depends only on the standard library so that it can
+be imported without pytest's compatibility code.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+import inspect
+from typing import Any
+
+
+__all__ = ["get_deep_partial_func"]
+
+
+def get_deep_partial_func(obj: Any) -> Any:
+    """Get the real function object of the (possibly) wrapped object by
+    :func:`functools.wraps`, or :func:`functools.partial`.
+
+    Unlike a single-level lookup, every nested :class:`functools.partial`
+    layer is peeled off.
+    """
+    obj = inspect.unwrap(obj)
+
+    while isinstance(obj, functools.partial):
+        obj = obj.func
+    return obj

@@ -0,0 +1,110 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import ModuleType
+from typing import Callable
+
+import pytest
+
+
+def _load_module() -> ModuleType:
+    path = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_deep_partial_function.py"
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_deep_partial_function", path
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+get_deep_partial_func = _load_module().get_deep_partial_func
+
+
+def func(a: int, b: int = 0, c: int = 0) -> int:
+    return a + b + c
+
+
+def test_plain_function_returned_unchanged() -> None:
+    assert get_deep_partial_func(func) is func
+
+
+def test_non_callable_returned_unchanged() -> None:
+    obj = object()
+    assert get_deep_partial_func(obj) is obj
+    assert get_deep_partial_func(None) is None
+
+
+def test_wraps_is_unwrapped() -> None:
+    @functools.wraps(func)
+    def wrapper(*args: int, **kwargs: int) -> int:
+        return func(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    assert get_deep_partial_func(wrapper) is func
+
+
+def test_single_partial() -> None:
+    assert get_deep_partial_func(functools.partial(func, 1)) is func
+
+
+def test_nested_partials_are_all_peeled() -> None:
+    inner = functools.partial(func, 1)
+    # Custom attributes prevent functools.partial from flattening the nesting.
+    inner.marker = "inner"  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    outer = functools.partial(inner, 2)
+    assert outer.func is inner
+
+    assert get_deep_partial_func(outer) is func
+
+
+def test_deeply_nested_partials() -> None:
+    obj: Callable[..., int] = func
+    for i in range(5):
+        obj = functools.partial(obj, i)
+        obj.level = i  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert get_deep_partial_func(obj) is func
+
+
+def test_wraps_around_nested_partials() -> None:
+    inner = functools.partial(func, 1)
+    inner.marker = "inner"  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    outer = functools.partial(inner, 2)
+
+    def wrapper() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    wrapper.__wrapped__ = outer  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert get_deep_partial_func(wrapper) is func
+
+
+def test_wrapped_inside_partial_not_unwrapped() -> None:
+    """Like get_real_func, unwrapping happens only before peeling partials."""
+
+    @functools.wraps(func)
+    def wrapper(*args: int, **kwargs: int) -> int:
+        return func(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    assert get_deep_partial_func(functools.partial(wrapper, 1)) is wrapper
+
+
+def test_unwrap_cycle_error_preserved() -> None:
+    def a() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    def b() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    a.__wrapped__ = b  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    b.__wrapped__ = a  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="wrapper loop"):
+        get_deep_partial_func(a)
+
+
+def test_does_not_import_pytest_compat() -> None:
+    source = (
+        Path(__file__).parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_deep_partial_function.py"
+    ).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "_pytest" not in source
+    assert "get_real_func" not in source
notes:
Added a stdlib-only get_deep_partial_func that mirrors get_real_func (inspect.unwrap first, errors preserved) but loops to peel every nested functools.partial layer; tests load the module by file path and cover nesting kept via custom attributes, wraps, cycles and non-callables.
